description:
tests/search_snippet_smoke_tests.rs cites the wrong RFC section:
  - line 4: "RFC 8621 §6 allows both"
  - line 10: "RFC 8621 §6 — SearchSnippet/get semantics"
  - line 11: "RFC 8621 §6.1 — request arguments"
  - line 134: "RFC 8621 §6 permits both"

SearchSnippet is RFC 8621 §5 (rfc8621.txt:3786-3982). §6 is Identities.

This is the kind of doc rot that snowballs: future contributors trust the
citation, search §6 of the RFC, find nothing about SearchSnippet, and waste
an hour resolving the discrepancy. Worse, they may "fix" the §5 reference
in search_snippet.rs to match the test files' §6, propagating the wrong
citation.

Fix: globally s/§6/§5/ in tests/search_snippet_smoke_tests.rs. The §6
references in the *factually wrong* "permits both threadIds and emailIds"
claim get deleted entirely as part of bd:JMAP-tjvm.6.
title: Spec citations in search_snippet test files say §6 instead of §5
